"""Continue the fixed V175 pipeline once; never retry a scientific worker."""

import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

REPO = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
ROOT = REPO / ".cache/quality-20261107/V175-fresh-noise-matching-v2"


def owner_live(owner):
    """Only absence, terminal state or a different creation time proves exit.

    AccessDenied/transient observation errors propagate to the wait loop and
    are never interpreted as worker completion.
    """
    try:
        process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
        return process.create_time() == owner["created"] and process.status() not in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE, psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        return False


def main():
    (ROOT / "completion-watch.claim").open("x").close()
    owner = dict(pid=os.getpid(), created=psutil.Process().create_time())
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    post = read(ROOT / "postprocess-inputs-v1.json")
    for binding in post["helpers"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    expected_source = read(ROOT / "completion-watch-source-v1.json")
    assert expected_source["worker"] == ref(__file__)
    python = str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python")
    last_log = 0.0

    def status(phase, **fields):
        nonlocal last_log
        record = dict(status=phase, owner=owner, observed_unix_UTC=time.time(), **fields)
        save(ROOT / "completion-watch-status-v1.json", record)
        if time.time() - last_log > 120 or not phase.startswith("waiting"):
            print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
            last_log = time.time()

    def wait_worker(phase, result_name):
        launch = read(ROOT / f"{phase}-launch-v1.json")
        target = launch["owner"]
        while True:
            try:
                live = owner_live(target)
            except (psutil.AccessDenied, OSError) as error:
                status(f"waiting-for-{phase}-observation", worker_owner=target, observation_error=repr(error))
                time.sleep(15)
                continue
            if live:
                status(f"waiting-for-{phase}", worker_owner=target)
                time.sleep(15)
                continue
            assert not (ROOT / f"{phase}-failure-v1.json").exists(), f"{phase} recorded a failure;manual review required"
            result = read(ROOT / result_name)
            assert result["status"].startswith("completed")
            assert result["owner"] == target
            status(f"{phase}-terminal-with-complete-result", worker_owner=target, result=ref(ROOT / result_name))
            return

    def cpu_phase(label, script, result_name):
        path = ROOT / result_name
        if path.exists():
            result = read(path)
            assert result["status"].startswith(("pass-", "completed-", "rendered-"))
            status(f"adopt-existing-{label}", result=ref(path))
            return
        claim = ROOT / f"watch-{label}.claim"
        claim.open("x").close()
        script = Path(script)
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts:{REPO}/.cache",
                   OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1", OMP_NUM_THREADS="2", MKL_NUM_THREADS="1", CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="")
        command = [python, str(script)]
        with (ROOT / f"watch-{label}-v1.log").open("xb") as log:
            status(f"running-{label}", command=command, source=ref(script))
            child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=REPO, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            save(ROOT / f"watch-{label}-launch-v1.json", dict(owner=dict(pid=child.pid, created=psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()), command=command, source=ref(script)))
            assert child.wait() == 0, f"{label} exited unsuccessfully;no retry"
        assert path.exists()
        status(f"completed-{label}", result=ref(path))

    try:
        guard(plan)
        wait_worker("train", "train-result-v1.json")
        cpu_phase("training-audit", REPO / ".cache/audit-v175-training-v1.py", "training-audit-v1.json")
        if not (ROOT / "review-launch-v1.json").exists():
            assert not (ROOT / "review.claim").exists() and not (ROOT / "review-failure-v1.json").exists()
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available <= plan["launch_RAM_GiB"] * 2**30:
                status("waiting-for-review-launch-RAM")
                time.sleep(15)
            guard(plan)
            status("launching-fixed-review")
            # This launch inherits the watcher's CUDA visibility. Only CPU
            # subprocesses above receive CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="".
            env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1")
            assert subprocess.run([python, plan["runner"]["path"], "launch-review"], cwd=REPO, env=env, check=False).returncode == 0
        wait_worker("review", "scores-v1.json")
        cpu_phase("quality-audit", REPO / ".cache/audit-v175-quality-v1.py", "quality-audit-v1.json")
        cpu_phase("offset-audit", REPO / ".cache/audit-v175-offsets-v1.py", "offset-audit-v1.json")
        cpu_phase("paired-reductions", REPO / ".cache/reduce-v175-fresh-noise-v1.py", "paired-comparisons-v1.json")
        cpu_phase("native-render", plan["renderer"]["path"], "figures-v1.json")
        status("ready-for-actual-native-viewing", figures=ref(ROOT / "figures-v1.json"), generated_report=False, published_exports=False)
        save(ROOT / "completion-watch-result-v1.json", dict(status="completed-fixed-audits-review-and-render-awaiting-human-viewing",
             owner=owner, source=ref(__file__), plan=ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"), new_direct_model_forwards=0,
             scientific_workers_launched_at_most_once=True, report_or_viewing_claims_generated=False))
    except BaseException as error:
        status("failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        save(ROOT / "completion-watch-failure-v1.json", dict(status="failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", owner=owner, error=repr(error), source=ref(__file__)))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
contents.scope: Eight CPU owner-status cases,including propagation of observation errors;no model or scientific phase launched by this check. Watcher must wait for the actual current owner and completed result,never restart training or an existing review.

scope: A detached local watcher will wait for authoritative training exit and completed result,run the frozen final training audit,launch the existing fixed review at most once,then run CPU quality/offset/reduction/render phases. It never restarts training or a failed/existing review;observation errors wait on the same owner. It stops on failures and never writes actual-viewing claims,human notes,final report or exports. The watcher and future children inherit nice10/CPU4,5 settings;CPU-only children hide CUDA while the quality launcher preserves normal visibility. Scientific model calls later belong to their separately recorded review owner,not a completed result claimed here.
